# omadafusion_auto_backup (Resource)

Scheduled controller backups (Maintenance > Backup > Auto Backup), saved on the controller. Controller-wide: use one instance. Creating it turns auto backup on; destroying it turns auto backup off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Weekly controller backup, Sunday 03:00, keep 8.
resource "omadafusion_auto_backup" "this" {
  schedule    = "weekly"
  day_of_week = 0
  hour        = 3
  max_files   = 8
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `day_of_month` (Number) For `monthly`: 1-31.
- `day_of_week` (Number) For `weekly`: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.
- `hour` (Number) Hour, 0-23, controller time zone.
- `max_files` (Number) Backup files to keep.
- `minute` (Number) Minute, 0-59.
- `schedule` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `auto_backup`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omadafusion_auto_backup.this auto_backup
```
